title: Nehemiah dissolves mixed marriages and purifies the priesthood
description: Nehemiah discovers that many Jews have married women from Ashdod, Ammon, and Moab, and that half of their children cannot speak Jewish. He rebukes the men, strikes some, pulls out their hair, and makes them swear not to give their daughters in mixed marriages. He points out how foreign women led Solomon astray. A son of the high priest Eliashib’s family who is Sanballat’s son-in-law is driven away. Nehemiah cleanses the priesthood and establishes duties for the priests and Levites. [ref:Neh 13:23-31|Nehemiah 13:23-31]
